name: BrandIllustration
description: One of Raft's two-colour pixel illustrations, drawn in ink and paper tokens. For brand surfaces only: the brand pane of sign-up and of the pages that create an account or a server. Decorative: hidden from assistive technology unless the caller names it with `aria-label`, which makes it an image.

props.name: cell
props.description: CSS pixels per cell: 8 (the default) on the brand pane, 4 where the drawing has to be small. The size is the drawing's grid times this; don't resize it with CSS, or its pixels come out uneven.
